title: Traditional Ukrainian Nutty Noodle Dish
description: A hearty and comforting Ukrainian-inspired dish featuring nutty and flaky noodles in a rich sauce. Perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: Cook the nutty noodles according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the dried thyme and rosemary, and stir to combine.
Add the cooked nutty noodles to the skillet, and toss to coat with the herb-infused oil.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the noodle mixture to a serving dish, and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
Cook the flaky noodles according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and serve on the side.
